correctness.rationale: For fixed unisolvent stencils, indicator sites and support weights, perturbing bounded data f by delta changes each residual indicator at rate at most Hx delta. The log of the positive unnormalized weight differentiates almost everywhere with rate at most tHx delta/epsilon. The normalized-weight covariance identity, weighted Cauchy-Schwarz and |Pj|<=Lx B give |K[f]-K[g]|<=Lx(1+tBHx/epsilon)delta, with no smoothness assumption on the data. In the actual six nodes (0,1/4,1,2,11/4,3), at x=3/2 exactly two equal geometric weights are active; first active branch 0, second 1, and the first residual changes to delta. Independently checked geometric support and exact formula K(delta)=(epsilon+delta)^t/[epsilon^t+(epsilon+delta)^t], giving derivative t/(4epsilon) and an O(1) output gap for delta=c epsilon. The bound is sharp in exponent, not in its prefactor; fixed stencils need not be selected by a particular implementation.
residual_risks: Fixed stencil family, geometric weights and indicator sets, not data-dependent stencil selection or moving mesh.
Six-node example is an admissible operator configuration, not guaranteed from a specific Leja selection heuristic.
